data.content_ref: inline:SRC_002 frames its relation as INHERITANCE from SRC_004, but the refutation condition it supplies actually defeats the inheritance rather than guarding it. The target says the inheritance is refuted if SRC_004's mechanism can be satisfied without the typed LEASE_MISMATCH contract. Yet genuine inheritance runs in the opposite direction: the child (SRC_002) must be substitutable wherever the parent (SRC_004) is used, not the reverse. If the parent's temporal constraint is satisfied by a generic 500 returned before the provider call, that demonstrates the parent is MORE general—which is exactly what inheritance requires, not what refutes it. The stated refutation condition would reject every valid specialization, so the proposal misidentifies its own relation kind.
